services.name: Executive Planner
services.description: Plans goals into scheduled projects, decomposes them into milestones/tasks, manages their lifecycle (status/progress/artifacts), groups them under companies, and consolidates recent activity into executive summaries.

services.name: Learning Engine
services.description: Tracks department/agent/tool execution outcomes and duration, and generates optimization recommendations from the aggregated performance data.

services.name: Automation Engine
services.description: Persisted job queue with retry/backoff and a recurring scheduler for background jobs (nightly consolidation, learning recommendations). The tick loop only runs while a long-running host process (the dashboard server) has started it.

services.name: Multi-Agent Collaboration
services.description: Agent-to-agent communication, delegation, review/critique, and consensus voting between departments. Constructed with an already-loaded departments array (see terminal.js/dashboard server.js), not a self-contained singleton.

services.name: Structured Logging
services.description: Leveled logging (debug/info/warn/error) with warn/error persisted to a durable error log, plus process-level uncaughtException/unhandledRejection crash guards installed on both entry points' real boot paths.

services.name: External Integrations
services.description: Obsidian vault read/write/index (configurable path, defaults to the repo root) and an allowlisted outbound HTTP connector (fails closed until SERVICE_ALLOWLIST is set). Reachable via the existing generic tool system -- no dedicated routes needed.

services.name: Known Devices Roster
services.description: Per-machine roster of every device this instance has ever synced with (first/last seen, sync count), built from the device identity already carried in every sync package. Complements the pre-existing core/device identity + sync mechanism with actual multi-device awareness.

services.name: Semantic Memory Index
services.description: Embedding-based (OpenAI) semantic memory search, additive to keyword search. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY and an explicit reindex; falls back to keyword search everywhere (including the Persistent Context Engine) when unconfigured or on any embedding-call failure.
